Feature.Description:
SiLA 2 Device Spectrum Acquisition feature - Provides control and data access for FTIR spectral measurements. It enables execution of spectrum analysis of samples with configuration of parameters such as spectral range, resolution and scan count. It also provides retrieval of spectral data in the form of wavenumber-absorbance pairs for previous measurements.
This feature separates scan configuration and calibration from execution. A client must first call 'ConfigureScanAndRunBackgroundScan' to set the measurement parameters and perform a background scan. Afterward, 'RunScan' can be called to acquire a sample spectrum using the active configuration.
This feature is intended to be used with the LockController feature. Intended usecase in automated analytical workflows involving FTIR instrumentation with only one sample holder and only requires data collection but does further analysis later in the workflow.

Command.Description: Sets the configuration for subsequent scans and initiates a background scan. Before the command is called a cleaning procedure should be performed on the FTIR instrument to avoid contamination of data. This command must be successfully completed before 'RunScan' can be called.

Parameter.Description: The desired configuration for the scan.

Command.Description: Initiates a scan of the currently inserted sample using the active configuration set by 'ConfigureScanAndRunBackground'. Retrieves the resulting spectrum data as a list of wavenumber-absorbance pairs. The server should be locked before calling this command.

Response.Description: Result of the scan operation, containing the spectrum data as a list of wavenumber-Absorbance pairs.

Element.Description: The wavenumber of the spectrum point.
The absorbance at the specified wavenumber.

Property.Description: The currently active configuration that will be used by the 'RunScan' command.
Maximum supported wavenumber for a scan
Minimum supported wavenumber for a scan
Supported measurement resolutions for a scan

DataTypeDefinition.Description: Unit of measurement used in spectroscopy, representing the number of wave cycles in a unit distance. The unit is here represented in reciprocal centimeters (cm-1), which is commonly used in FTIR spectroscopy.
A structure holding all configuration settings for a scan operation.

Element.Description: The maximum wavenumber of the spectral range to be measured. Upper Wavenumber must be greater than or equal to the Lower Wavenumber. Upper Wavenumber must be less than or equal to Maximum Supported Wavenumber (see property).

The minimum wavenumber of the spectral range to be measured. Lower Wavenumber must be less than or equal to the Upper Wavenumber. Lower Wavenumber must be greater than or equal to Minimum Supported Wavenumber (see property).
Measurement resolution in wavenumbers. Must be in the set of Supported Resolutions (see property).
Number of scans to average for the sample.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: The 'RunScan' command was called before a scan configuration was successfully set by the 'ConfigureScanAndRunBackground' command.
The provided scan configuration parameters are not valid or supported by the device. Check the supported value ranges provided by the feature's properties.
